raw_response:
Aiya, okay, let me think it through for you. I'm not good with numbers like the young people, but after fifty years on this land I know what works.

**The land**

I got 15.3 mu all together. Ten mu of it is the good piece near the road, that's my wheat-and-maize field, been doing wheat-then-maize there since they let us have our own plots. The other 5.3 mu is on the drier side, farther from the canal, so I put cotton there. Cotton can take the heat better than maize if the water doesn't come.

**Wheat** — already in the ground since last October, the 10th or so, same day every year more or less. I used Jimai, the kind my cousin grows, cheap seed, reliable. Before planting I put one bag of the 15-15-15 compound per mu, that's about 40 kg. Now in spring when the wheat greens up I'll open the well and give it the greening water, then again at jointing I topdress urea — maybe 15 kg per mu, depends how it looks. If the leaves are dark green and strong I put less, if yellow I put more. Last year I got around 430 kg per mu, nothing special, but nothing bad either. I'll irrigate 3 times if heaven doesn't send rain — electric is expensive now, over 40 yuan each time.

**Maize** — soon as wheat comes off in June I got to be quick, no more than four or five days. Hire the rotary tiller man (40 yuan per mu he charges now, used to be 25, aiya). Plant Zhengdan hybrid, my seed shop sells it, 40 yuan per mu for seed. Base fertilizer same as wheat, one bag compound. When the maize is knee-high I topdress urea. Maize is easier than wheat, doesn't need as much fussing. I irrigate once or twice if the summer is dry, otherwise rain is usually enough. Last year got about 470 kg.

**Cotton** — this one is the troublesome one. My back can't do cotton like when I was forty, but the price last year was not so bad and my wife can still pick. I cut back from 8 mu to 5.3 mu over the years. Plant end of April under plastic mulch, buy hybrid seed (60 yuan per mu, expensive but worth it). Fertilizer same idea — compound at planting, urea when it starts to square. Must spray for bollworm and aphids, three or four times through the summer. My son comes from town on weekends in picking time, otherwise just me and his mother. Got maybe 230 kg lint per mu last year.

**Labor and money**

Kids work in town, only come for big jobs. Most of the work is just me and my wife. For harvest I hire the combine for wheat and maize, about 50 yuan per mu. Cotton picking is all by hand, no machine for that around here.

Money is tight this year. Urea went up again, heard it's 125 yuan per bag now. I'll buy what I need but not one bag more. No room to experiment at my age. What worked last year should work this year unless heaven decides otherwise.
